correction_background.root_cause: BTC permitted_instance_counts was (1,) — instance_count=0 from a stopped recorder was rejected as 'task identity or policy mismatch' before the readiness engine could classify TASK_NOT_RUNNING and STALE_HEARTBEAT.
correction_background.fix: Changed permitted_instance_counts from (1,) to (0, 1). Zero instances is accepted as authentic runtime evidence (not healthy). Duplicate instances (>=2) remain prohibited.
correction_background.live_verification: BTC is now Running and Healthy with zero gaps; ES/NQ remained untouched. Watchdog correctly failed closed as HEALTH_EVALUATION_FAILED; drill controller automatically restarted BTC.

observations.description: BTC permitted_instance_counts changed from (1,) to (0,1). Zero instances accepted as authentic runtime evidence. instance_count=1 remains healthy.
instance_count=0 with task_state=Ready produces TASK_NOT_RUNNING. Ready state alone cannot establish health.
Heartbeat older than BTC 90-second SLA produces STALE_HEARTBEAT. Stopped+stale produces both TASK_NOT_RUNNING and STALE_HEARTBEAT.
instance_count>=2 rejects as identity/policy mismatch. Duplicate instances remain prohibited.
Wrong task name, wrong script path still reject. ES/NQ identity unchanged: Ready/Running, (0,1) instances, 93600s SLA.
trading_authority=false in report, readiness, and JSON output. Stopped/stale reports also have trading_authority=false.
No network/credential/task-mutation imports. Only json, pathlib, datetime, operational_resilience, owner_context_health_adapter used.
New regression test test_stopped_stale_btc_is_classified_unhealthy_not_rejected verifies stopped+stale BTC produces both TASK_NOT_RUNNING and STALE_HEARTBEAT without throwing.
